title: Eddie H NDE 31843
content: On 10/08/2010, I was involve in a very bad car accident. I was hit really bad on the driver’s side of my car. The car that hit me pushed my car into a house pinning me inside the car. I was stuck inside my car between the other car and the house. I was unconscious in my car. The fire department had to use the Jaws of Life to cut me out. While I was in the car, I was unconscious but I saw a white lady dressed in white and she reach out for me with her hand and told me to take her hand and walk to the park with her and I’ll feel no pain! I looked at her in her face but I couldn't see her face! I saw her body and hand but couldn't see her face. It looked like I was looking through a glass cup full of water! She felt so warm and happy! But I didn't take her hand because it felt strange and in the same time I heard far away a person screaming out, ‘can you hear me, can you hear me?’ I was going to grab the lady’s hand but I had flash back of my family who love me and I didn't grab the lady’s hand. I woke up in the ambulance hearing EMS say to me, ‘can you hear me,’ and I said yeah and where was I? He explained to me what happened and I couldn't believe it! During the ride to the hospital, I kept losing consciousness and I kept hearing the lady ask me the same question! Up to now, I’m home after a month in the hospital and I’m not well. I feel really scared and I feel like there is someone watching me everywhere I go! I live in fear of going to sleep and never waking up!

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'white lady dressed in white' who reached out her hand; her face could not be seen ('like I was looking through a glass cup full of water').

environment.environment_other_detail: She invited him to 'walk to the park' with her (no further description of the park/realm).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe car accident; hit on driver's side and pinned between another car and a house; extricated with the Jaws of Life.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Unconscious during extrication; encounter with a 'white lady dressed in white' inviting him to take her hand and go to the park; heard EMS voice calling 'can you hear me?' and then awoke in ambulance.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He simultaneously perceived the lady inviting him and heard a distant voice saying 'can you hear me?'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He could see the woman's body and hand but not her face ('like I was looking through a glass cup full of water'). He reports continued episodes of losing consciousness in the ambulance and repeatedly hearing the lady ask the same question.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “take her hand and walk to the park with her and I’ll feel no pain!”; “can you hear me, can you hear me?”; “It looked like I was looking through a glass cup full of water!”; “I feel really scared and I feel like there is someone watching me everywhere I go!”
